description: This file manages booking fields for event types, including retrieving event type data, adding/updating/removing booking fields, and handling associated data via Prisma ORM.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Fetches an event type by ID, including related custom inputs, profile, and workflows, and determines if it's an organization team event.

methods.name: upsertBookingField
methods.description: Adds or updates a booking field for a specific event type, managing sources and required status.

methods.name: removeBookingField
methods.description: Removes a specific source from a booking field, and deletes the field if no sources remain.
